# Hello read these words thank you
Welcome to this server thingy. There are few rules that you should probably follow.
## Harassment, Discrimination, Toxicity, Ect. Being mean to someone beyond roleplay purposes is not acceptable. Violating someones privacy in any way, such as doxxing, is not acceptable. Have something nice to say about other developers and communities or don't say anything. No doing illegal computer stuff on the server.
## Roleplay If you're going to play the roleplaying game, you should roleplay. When you die and become something else, don't act on knowledge from your previous life. Don't use metacommunications. It's nice to be with friends playing the same game, just regularly meet up or get into the same job/role/cult to talk. Try not to use game terms while speaking in game. Don't become evil for no reason. You need a moderately good (or funny) reason to self antag. No ERP at any time. You will explode.
## Escalation If you aren't security (or salvage) ((or an antag)), you should't collect or carry weapons around when everythings fine. If you have a disagreement with someone, you ought to try talking before doing anything physical. Of course, self defence is exempt. As are violent antags. Security should be trying their hardest to de-escalate situations. And antags in position to do so should give them a moment to negotiate.
## Other If there are technical problems, you are being harassed, or things are getting too boring, get in contact with your local admins. We are here to help*
